summary: Academia EduNet - Centro de Videos Tutoriales module fully tested. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Backend: DELETE /api/academia/subcategories/{id} - deletes empty subcategory

Backend: POST /api/academia/youtube/extract - returns is_valid=false for invalid URLs
